title: Genesis 4:1-2 — Were Cain and Abel twins? Most likely
summary: Genesis 4:1-2 in English with colour-coded words: one conception (Eve conceived once) but two births (Cain, then Abel). The slide concludes that Cain and Abel were most likely twins.

text.text: 1 And the man knew Eve [chava] his wife,
and she conceived and gave birth to Cain,
and she said, “I have obtained a man את the LORD.”
2 And again, she gave birth to his brother Abel.
And Abel was a keeper of flocks, but Cain was a cultivator of the ground.
Were Cain & Abel twins?  Most Likely

words.gloss: untranslated Hebrew object marker (alef-tav), left in the English verse

keywords: I have gotten a man from the LORD
